notes: The Compass tab has been removed. It was the most complicated thing in the app, and the heading dial, its calibration banner, the marked bearing and the true-north switch went with it. MeasureT now has six tabs and opens on Convert.

The currency answer could be cut off at the bottom of its card on a phone with larger text, which is why the number was hard to see. The card now grows to fit what is in it instead of being squeezed, the answer is larger and darker, and the labels above it are legible.
Nothing else changed — elevation, location, the level, the converter, GPS measuring, the AR range finder, permissions and updates are exactly as they were.
